name: bidmanager-control-shell
description: Electron wrapper for the BidManager Control admin console

scripts.electron:dev: node ../../node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -k "npm --prefix .. run dev" "node ../../node_modules/wait-on/bin/wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:5174 && node ../../node_modules/cross-env/src/bin/cross-env.js ELECTRON_DEV=1 ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5174 BIDMANAGER_PORT=8090 node ../../node_modules/electron/cli.js ."
